_note: The ARES boss ladder: Discord handles only, each an original stylized character with the handle as its name tag. Rename or remove anyone in one edit here. Order is the ladder; the last entry is the final boss.
credit: Bosses: the Nous Hermes hackathon Discord

bosses.title: The Showstopper
bosses.theme: a cabaret ringmaster who runs the arena like a stage show
bosses.attack: sweeping spotlight beams and confetti bombs

bosses.title: The Salt Shaker
bosses.theme: a crystal-armoured duelist who is always a little salty
bosses.attack: salt-crystal volleys and a salt rain

bosses.title: YES SIR
bosses.theme: a drill-sergeant sprinter who answers every order at full speed
bosses.attack: a charging rush across the arena

bosses.title: Needs a Beating
bosses.theme: a tanky brawler who wants a proper fight

bosses.title: The Ghost
bosses.attack: phases out and reappears behind you

bosses.title: The Discount
bosses.theme: a flashy merchant running the biggest sale in the arena

bosses.title: Three-Business Tycoon
bosses.theme: an entrepreneur running three ventures at once

bosses.title: The Slow Clanker
bosses.theme: a lovable robot that takes forever to wind up
bosses.attack: a very long wind-up, then a huge hit

bosses.title: The Hotfix
bosses.theme: a late-night patcher who rewrites the arena mid-fight
bosses.attack: blinks around and drops patch pillars of fire

bosses.title: The Microfreak
bosses.theme: a synth wizard with a 25-key keyboard
bosses.attack: sound waves fire in key patterns

bosses.title: The Bell
bosses.theme: a calm, graceful bell dancer (suzu means bell)

bosses.title: The Eye
bosses.theme: a giant floating eye that sees the whole arena

bosses.title: The Moderator
bosses.theme: the arena's moderator, keeping every fight on topic
bosses.attack: a timeout hammer that freezes you and an on-topic shockwave that silences you

bosses.title: The Hermes Architect
bosses.theme: a wise winged messenger who summons glowing model checkpoints
bosses.attack: checkpoint swarms, messenger beams and wing gusts
